description.value: The Brunch Club & Coffee Bar is a cafe and brunch spot on Canyon Street in Creston, in the heart of the Kootenay region. It offers a drinks menu alongside its food offerings and supports online ordering. Creston sits on a main touring corridor between the Rockies and the Okanagan, making a brunch stop here a natural fit for cyclists passing through.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at thebrunchclub.ca is live and confirms the business name, address (1015 Canyon St, Creston BC), and phone (250-402-9233), all matching OSM tags. The site includes an 'Order Online' navigation link, providing positive evidence for takeout. No mention of bike parking, washrooms, water refill, Wi-Fi, or any other cyclist-specific amenities appears anywhere in the fetched content.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, active cafe in Creston with a confirmed live website, matching contact details, and online ordering. A straightforward include for the directory.
enrichment_extras.notes: Menu and About Us subpages returned minimal content; full menu details and amenity information (dietary options, washrooms, etc.) could not be confirmed from the fetched text.

wow_evidence: cafe and brunch spot on Canyon Street in Creston
